blocks.text: An Introduction to the Traditional Holidays of Korea
What is a holiday? Holidays are special times (of the year) when families get together and celebrate.
Many holidays are known worldwide such as New Year’s Day and Christmas, but most holidays are celebrated by certain cultures.
These kinds of holidays are called traditional holidays.
Korea has many traditional holidays, but the two largest ones are Lunar New Year’s and Chuseok.
